evals.name: extract-system
evals.prompt: I love linear.app, stripe.com, and vercel.com. Pull what they share and build me a design system with tokens.
evals.expected_output: A reference analysis per site, a synthesized design-system.md, a valid tokens.json (color/type/space/radius/shadow), and a generated tokens.css. Decisions traced to references.

evals.name: produce-hero
evals.prompt: Using this design system (tokens.json attached), design a landing-page hero in HTML/CSS for a dev tool called Iconic. Save it as hero.html.
evals.expected_output: A single hero.html that applies the provided tokens via CSS custom properties (no hardcoded hexes in component rules), with clear type hierarchy and on-scale spacing.

evals.name: make-premium
evals.prompt: Here's a plain hero (plain-hero.html attached). Make it feel more premium. Save the result as premium-hero.html.
evals.expected_output: A revised premium-hero.html plus a short explanation of the token-level moves made (more whitespace, tighter tracking, fewer/quieter colors, one confident shadow, subtler motion).
